entries.title: Dispatch window type mismatch
entries.root_cause: The dispatch window decoder passes a String to DispatchWindow, which requires a FiniteDuration. The decoder must parse the duration before constructing the window.

entries.title: Missing ledger method
entries.root_cause: The reconciliation code calls a nonexistent sealBatch method on EscapementLedger. The call must be updated to the ledger's available API.

entries.title: Dispatch window type mismatch
entries.root_cause: The dispatch window decoder passes a String to DispatchWindow, which requires a FiniteDuration. The decoder must parse the duration before constructing the window.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later run compiles more sources on a newer runner; the decoder moved lines and unrelated build output changed.

entries.title: Retention period type mismatch
entries.root_cause: The retention policy decoder passes a String to RetentionPeriod, which requires a FiniteDuration. Its separate retention setting must be parsed before constructing the period.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e1, this is a String versus FiniteDuration compiler error, but it is in a different decoder and requires fixing the retention setting rather than the dispatch window.
